# Rune Compass — skins index

**Generated by measurement, not by hand.** Regenerate with
`verify-local.ps1`, which fails if this file disagrees with the filesystem.
`docs/SHADOW_GENOME.md` Failure #7 is what that check exists to prevent: an index that
had been reporting numbers nobody had measured, for its whole life.

Authoring rules for every asset below: `RuneCompass/Assets/Skins/ART_SPEC.md`.

## Coverage

- Skins: **3**
- Live assets required: **15** (5 per skin)
- Present: **6**
- Missing: **9** — each falls back to mod-drawn primitive geometry with
  identical motion, so every skin stays playable while its art is finished

## Folder structure

```text
RuneCompass/Assets/Skins/
├── ART_SPEC.md          authoring rules: canvas, orientation, palettes
├── SKINS_INDEX.md       this file
├── ClassicWood/
│   ├── skin.json
│   ├── base.png
│   ├── ring.png
│   ├── character_arrow.png
│   ├── camera_wedge.png
│   ├── wind_gust.png
├── MinimalNordic/
│   ├── skin.json
│   ├── base.png
│   ├── ring.png
│   ├── character_arrow.png
│   ├── camera_wedge.png
│   ├── wind_gust.png
├── RuneRing/
│   ├── skin.json
│   ├── base.png
│   ├── ring.png
│   ├── character_arrow.png
│   ├── camera_wedge.png
│   ├── wind_gust.png
```

Filenames are canonical: the loader reads whatever `skin.json` names, but keeping them
uniform is what lets this index be generated rather than maintained.

## Roles

| file | `skin.json` key | role | artwork occupies |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base.png` | `baseTexture` | static backing plate | full dial |
| `ring.png` | `ringTexture` | the dial face; fixed, carries N/E/S/W | full dial |
| `character_arrow.png` | `characterArrowTexture` | THE needle: which way the character faces | ~45% centred |
| `camera_wedge.png` | `cameraWedgeTexture` | where the camera looks; quiet background sector | ~86%, 60 deg span |
| `wind_gust.png` | `windGustTexture` | small rune orbiting OUTSIDE the rim, marking the quarter wind comes FROM | ~13%, drawn centred |
